elena (finance): FYI — I'm seeing a mismatch between Stripe and NetSuite for a batch of tiered-usage invoices for early March. Stripe shows discounts applied; NetSuite total is higher (discount missing). Can someone triage?

sam (platform): Can you drop the Stripe invoice id + NetSuite record id? also any webhook ids/timestamps? :thinking:

elena (finance): Stripe invoice id inv_3JYk9L2QwX, NetSuite transaction NS_INV_8790. Webhook events around 2026-03-09T22:12:45Z. Quick log snippet from webhook processor:

```
2026-03-09T22:12:45Z POST /webhooks/stripe 200 OK
payload.event=invoice.payment_succeeded
processor=ns-sync-v2
result=ok
warning=discount_lookup_failed price_id=price_ABC123 plan_code=null
```

sam (platform): That's helpful. Looks like our discount mapping keyed off plan_code which is null for tiered usage pricing when the price uses quantity tiers. I think the mapping fallback didn't run. :facepalm:

stripe-bot: event invoice.payment_succeeded recorded at 1863996765 for inv_3JYk9L2QwX

nathan (ops): I can reproduce locally. The sync job calls /apply-discount with body {"plan_code": null, "price_id": "price_ABC123"} and our NetSuite adapter expects an item-level discount id, not a price_id. Quick fix: add price->discount resolution using price_metadata.discount_id. I'll open a patch.

sophie (revops): Before we re-run any sync/backfill, we need finance sign-off — those invoices may have already been posted and collected. If we change totals we have to issue credit memos. Approval? :warning:

elena (finance): Approved for a limited backfill (invoices 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-12) but must be dry-run first. Please produce a delta report showing #invoices, total delta, and list of affected customer IDs.

sam (platform): Doing dry-run now. Will run ns-sync-v2 --dry-run --filter-date 2026-03-01..2026-03-12 and output CSV. Expect ~20-30 invoices.

nathan (ops): Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ns-sync/pull/412 — adds price_metadata lookup and fallback to compute discount_id for tiered prices. I'll also add a metric for discount_lookup_failures.

sam (platform): Dry-run results: 17 invoices would change, net delta = -$248.00 (i.e., credits owed). Attached sample SQL used for reporting:```sql
-- sample delta extract
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, original_total_cents, corrected_total_cents, (corrected_total_cents - original_total_cents) AS delta_cents
FROM ns_sync_dry_run
WHERE delta_cents != 0;
```

sophie (revops): Thx. Can you post the CSV and a short list of enterprise customers affected? We'll coordinate credit memos with accounting. Also estimate API/NetSuite rate limits for re-run.

sam (platform): CSV uploaded to /shared/finance/dry-runs/1864001234-delta.csv. Enterprise customers: cust_88, cust_412, cust_901. Re-run will do about 30 NetSuite patch requests spread across an hour to avoid hitting our daily throughput.

elena (finance): Sounds good. Please include GL impact summary and confirm that the change only affects discount lines, not revenue recognition. If rev rec changes, stop and escalate to accounting manager.

nathan (ops): Confirmed: changes are discount memo adjustments (credit memos). Rev rec unaffected. I will schedule a backfill job in the release window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC and will throttle to 1 req/2s.

sophie (revops): I'll prepare Customer comms templates for the three enterprise accounts and coordinate credit memo numbers.

sam (platform): Deploying patch to staging now, running end-to-end test with staging Stripe + sandbox NetSuite. Test invoice -> webhook -> ns-sync -> create credit memo passes.

elena (finance): Great. Post results after the production dry-run and before issuing any credits. :thumbsup:

stripe-bot: deployment ns-sync-v2 patched discount lookup — staging run passed at 1864001550

nathan (ops): Production run started 1864001700 (throttled). I'll post a completion summary when done.

sam (platform): Completion summary: 17 invoices adjusted, total credits issued $248.00, credit memos created NS_CM_1201..NS_CM_1217, no failed requests. CSV and NetSuite audit links uploaded.

elena (finance): Closing the loop — reconciled amounts match Stripe. Thanks team. Filing a postmortem on root cause (missing price_metadata mapping) and adding an alert for discount_lookup_failures to catch future regressions. :white_check_mark:
